notes: ~189k Seattle parcels -> PMTiles + H3 hexes. Source: King County GIS one-stop parcel layer (geometry + APPRLNDVAL/APPR_IMPR + PREUSE_DESC), clipped to the City of Seattle municipal boundary (see run_seattle.py). Condos are mapped at the complex level by the county, so no per-unit stub merge is needed; run_seattle.py DOES merge King County's split multi-parcel developments (improvement value dumped on one "minor" beside zeroed siblings) so complexes no longer render as lone purple towers. NMA (Neighborhood Map Atlas) region show/hide toggles, like Houston — on BOTH the Land Value (3D) tab and the Parking tab. Columns added by augment_seattle_regions.py; the bake emits metadata.groups for each (H3_CATEGORICAL_FIELDS).
